results.title: Uncle Vanya (1970 film)
results.text: Uncle Vanya (Russian: Дядя Ваня , "Dyadya Vanya " ) is a 1970 film adaptation of the Anton Chekhov play of the same title and directed by Andrey Konchalovskiy.

results.title: Uncle Vanya (1963 film)
results.text: Uncle Vanya is a 1963 British film adaptation of the work "Uncle Vanya" by Anton Chekhov. The film was directed by Stuart Burge. It was a filmed version of the Chichester Festival production, directed by (and starring) Laurence Olivier as Astrov, and also starring Michael Redgrave (Vanya), Rosemary Harris (Elena), and Joan Plowright (Sonya).
